article.title: The Easiest Way to Make the World Smarter Was Already in Your Kitchen
article.coreIdea: A tiny, almost invisible public-health intervention (iodine added to salt at the factory) produced enormous population-scale cognitive gains — the world got smarter through a supply chain nobody noticed.
article.emotionalTone: quiet awe at infrastructure; documentary; intelligent; understated
article.visualMetaphor: domestic object with global-scale implication — the kitchen counter as the endpoint of a worldwide engineering decision
